labels: [amount, date_time, env, sla]
patterns:
  amount:
    - "(?:NT\\$|USD|US\\$|\\$|＄)\\s?[0-9０-９][0-9０-９,，]*(?:[\\.．][0-9０-９]+)?"
  date_time:
    - "\\b[12][0-9]{3}[./-][0-9]{1,2}[./-][0-9]{1,2}\\b"
    - "\\b[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}\\b"
    - "\\b[12][0-9]{3}年[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日\\b"
    - "\\b[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日\\b"
  env:
    - "\\b(prod|production|prd|staging|stage|stg|uat|test|dev)\\b"
  sla:
    - "\\b(SLA|RTO|RPO|EOD|EOW)\\b"
    - "(?:\\d+|\\d+\\.\\d+)\\s*(?:小時|小時內|天|日)\\b"
<<< CONTENT-END
----- FILE-END :: versions/kie_20250830T054845Z/ruleset.yml
